_how: The looks on /panel. Edit freely: changes show up on the panel within a few seconds, no restart. prompt = words added to every prompt (avatar and world); negative = added to the negative prompt (only used when guidance > 1); filter = a browser filter over the finished picture: "", "pixel", "line" or "matrix"; lora = [file in loras/, weight]: picking the look also puts that LoRA in slot A (if the file is there).
